{{Quote|I left my bag and strongbox in the cave, though. Will you go get them for me? I can't go any further inside.|[[Pech Seki]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:MQ">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Meatlump Quitting|Corellia}}</ref>}}
The '''Meatlump Cave''' was a large [[Cave/Legends|cave]] near the city of [[Tyrena/Legends|Tyrena]] on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. It was used as a base of operations of the technology-hating [[Meatlumps|Meatlump gang]].

==Description==
[[File:Meatlump_Cave_interior.jpg|thumb|left|250px|A tent used by the Meatlumps inside the cave.]]
The only entrance to the cave could be found in a rock formation that rose from a hill on the Corellian plains. The Meatlumps used torches to light the dark cave. They had brought tents, primitive tables and chairs to the cave along with simple generators. Among the Meatlumps living in the cave were [[Ubbal Fenn]],<ref name="SWG:CCFAaB" /> [[Pech Seki]]<ref name="SWG:MQ" /> and [[Hrath Koo]].<ref name="SWG:HKMD">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Hrath Koo Must Die|Corellia}}</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|That Meatlump Hrath Koo has bothered me for the last time! He comes into my shop and destroys whatever I'm working on. But no more! Because I'm going to pay you to go into that cave and stop him.|[[Teilo Monnro]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:HKMD" />}}
[[File:HrathKooMustDie-GH.jpg|thumb|right|200px|[[Hrath Koo]] attacked by a [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]].]]
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the Meatlumps attacked the [[Captain/Legends#Civilian use|starship captain]] [[Osto Grissom]] because he transported electronics into and out of the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]]. [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Alana Walden|Walden]] from the [[Corellian Security Force]] employed the services of an independent agent to help with the investigation. The agent tracked the Meatlumps to this location and entered the cave by force. During the ensuing fight, several members of the gang were killed, including Hrath Koo. The agent also destroyed much of the Meatlumps' equipment, including weapon caches, armor lockers and food stores to force Ubbal Fenn to reveal their reasons for the attack on Grissom.<ref name="SWG:CCFAaB" /> The CorSec agent also helped the Meatlump Pech Seki, who wanted to leave the gang, find his belongings that he had left behind in the cave.<ref name="SWG:MQ" /> The spacer finally killed the Meatlumps Hrath Koo in the cave because he harassed [[Teilo Monnro]].<ref name="SWG:HKMD" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Meatlump Cave was a location [[Sony]] Online Entertainment's [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'',<ref name="SWG:CCFAaB" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Meatlump Cave was added to the game with the update named "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 1|Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives]]", published on [[June 8]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives, Publish Notes, June 8th">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=DevDiscussion&message.id=48548|text="Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives", Publish Notes, June 8th}}</ref> It could be found not far from the town of Tyrena on Corellia. The player visits this cave during the quest "[[:w:c:swg:CorSec Case Files: Assault and Battery|CorSec Case Files: Assault and Battery]]," which was a part of the [[:w:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy quest]], the longest quest line of the game.<ref name="SWG:CCFAaB" />
